Tesla Model Y has been the world’s best-selling passenger vehicle for 3 consecutive years

2023 → #1  
2024 → #1  
2025 → #1

Model Y alone has surpassed 4 million global sales, while Tesla has now delivered more than 10 million vehicles worldwide

Not just the best-selling EV

Model Y beat every gas, hybrid and electric passenger vehicle worldwide for three straight years

An electric car reaching this scale would have sounded impossible not long ago

Now millions of Model Ys are on roads around the world
